messages:
Emma Li: Quick async check on region rollout status for SGP and NL-west. Focus items are KMS grants for dedicated accounts, DNS delegations + healthcheck alignment, and routing policy for latency-based failover. Owners: Dmitri (network), Ben (infra provisioning), Carla (security/KMS). Can each confirm ETA and any PRs we should watch? Also need code review for routing policy PR :eyes:

Dmitri Kozlov: I can take the routing policy. Plan to push `routing-policy-v2` after one more integration test run — hoping for tomorrow. PR: #927 (links in PR description). Need Alice to check the `prefer-eu` match order and community lists.

Alice Nguyen: Skimmed #927, small nit on the `prefer-eu` reorder. Will put an approval by EOD if tests pass. Also we should set staging healthcheck TTL to 60s to match DNS TTLs. Pinged ops.

Ben Carter: Provisioning for SGP infra is mostly done, subnet peering from partner account is still pending (ticket INF-412). For KMS, we need Carla to add decrypt/grant for the `redwood-dedicated-role` on the CMK. ETA for peering is Wed pending partner response.

Carla Mendez: I will handle KMS grants. Short checklist i'm following: 1) create CMK alias `alias/rw-sgp-dedicated`, 2) attach key policy for `redwood-dedicated-role`, 3) enable rotation. I'll open a terraform PR with the diff and request reviewers. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Emma Li: Perfect. Please drop links to the PRs here when created. Runbook/notes link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/region-rollout/sgp-nl — add rollback steps and verification commands.

infra-bot: Deploy job `deploy/sgp-routes` started by Dmitri Kozlov. Build: 2026.3.12. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2026.3.12/927

Dmitri Kozlov: Heads-up I'll be OOO Fri morning; if route changes land then follow the revert steps in the runbook. I'll leave a checklist in the PR description.

Ben Carter: I'll follow up on INF-412 and update this thread. For canary plan: 5% traffic -> monitor latency/errors for 30m -> ramp to 25% -> 100% if green.

Carla Mendez: KMS PR created: #954 (terraform). Adding reviewers: @Ben Carter, @Alice Nguyen, @Emma Li. Will include IAM policy snippet in the PR.

Alice Nguyen: Approved PR #927 and PR #954. :white_check_mark: With approvals we can canary on Wed. Propose Wed 15:00 UTC for 5% canary — any objections?

Emma Li: Wed 15:00 UTC works for me. I'll schedule the rollout and notify SRE oncall. Who covers Thu AM oncall? Dmitri is primary Thu-Fri; can someone cover Thu AM? @Ben?

Ben Carter: I can cover Thu AM if needed. Also reminder: tag resources with `data_residency` and include region tag in Terraform modules.

Emma Li: Thanks all. Final action items: Dmitri - finalize routing PR and leave revert steps; Ben - confirm INF-412 peering ticket and canary gating; Carla - KMS TF PR and attach policy; Alice - finalize healthcheck thresholds and approve in staging; I'll send the calendar invite and update the confluence page. :rocket:
